d: The Quad is stepping up its presence in the Indo-Pacific. At their meeting in Manila, leaders from India, the US, Japan and Australia announced a new maritime surveillance initiative to strengthen information-sharing and monitor activity across the region. The grouping also plans its first joint maritime exercise involving P-8 and P-3C patrol aircraft in 2027. What does this mean for the future of the Indo-Pacific? Palki Sharma tells you.
